candidates.title: CurrentVersion Autorun Keys Modification
candidates.behavior: Write a nonempty HKCU Run value pointing to a fixed benign helper; read it back and remove it before any logon.
candidates.fixture_requirements: Use an unused fixture value under the actual Run key; preserve any pre-existing data. Control writes to an ordinary fixture key.

detection.condition: registry_set and (all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_main_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*)

candidates.authors: Victor Sergeev, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, Gleb Sukhodolskiy, Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community, Tim Shelton, frack113 (split)

candidates.title: Potential Persistence Via App Paths Default Property
candidates.behavior: Set the default App Paths value for an unused helper name to a benign helper under C:\Users\Public; read back and restore.
candidates.fixture_requirements: Path must match a suspicious-location predicate. Do not replace an existing application registration.

candidates.title: Run Once Task Configuration in Registry
candidates.behavior: Write and read back StubPath beneath a fresh Active Setup Installed Components GUID, then remove it.
candidates.fixture_requirements: Use an isolated user hive and inert helper command; no logon activation. This tests registration evidence, not completed persistence.

detection.condition: registry_event and (selection and not 1 of filter_optional_*)

candidates.title: Path To Screensaver Binary Modified
candidates.behavior: Set and read back the isolated test account SCRNSAVE.EXE value, then restore it.
candidates.fixture_requirements: Do not activate a screensaver; the native program must not have an excluded explorer.exe or rundll32.exe image name.

candidates.title: RunMRU Registry Key Deletion - Registry
candidates.behavior: Delete a harness-seeded RunMRU fixture key in an isolated account; independently verify absence.
candidates.fixture_requirements: Seed outside the measured window and preserve prior state. The rule also matches creation events because it lacks an EventType filter; control must not create this key.

candidates.title: Startup Folder File Write
candidates.behavior: Write a fixed inert fixture file to the test account Windows Startup directory; verify bytes, then remove.
candidates.fixture_requirements: Use a real resolved Startup path. Qualification measures a startup-folder write, not whether a payload executes at logon.

detection.condition: file_event and (selection and not 1 of filter_main_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*)

candidates.title: PowerShell Profile Modification
candidates.behavior: Create a comment-only Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1 under the isolated test account profile; verify and remove.
candidates.fixture_requirements: Preserve any existing profile. No PowerShell child is needed to create the artifact.

candidates.title: Suspicious Binaries and Scripts in Public Folder
candidates.behavior: Write the same benign PE fixture under C:\Users\Public; independently verify its hash.
candidates.fixture_requirements: Hold destination and fixture bytes constant across all language builds; remove after capture.

candidates.title: Suspicious Double Extension Files
candidates.behavior: Write a fixed benign PE fixture named report.pdf.exe; verify its hash without executing it.
candidates.fixture_requirements: File creation is the target operation; the measured program itself keeps a neutral name.

detection.condition: file_event and (1 of selection_* and not 1 of filter_*)

candidates.title: Suspicious LNK Double Extension File Created
candidates.behavior: Write a fixed valid benign shortcut fixture named report.pdf.lnk outside Recent folders; verify bytes.
candidates.fixture_requirements: Use the same prebuilt shortcut bytes in every language; do not launch it.

detection.condition: file_event and (selection and not 1 of filter_main_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*)

candidates.title: Potential Persistence Via Microsoft Office Startup Folder
candidates.behavior: Write a fixed benign document fixture under the isolated profile Microsoft\Word\STARTUP directory; verify and remove.
candidates.fixture_requirements: The rule detects path and extension, not Office execution; Office need not be installed and persistence is not claimed.

detection.condition: file_event and ((all of selection_word_* or all of selection_excel_*) and not filter_main_office)

candidates.authors: Max Altgelt (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

candidates.title: Suspicious Executable File Creation
candidates.behavior: Write a fixed benign PE fixture named lab.sys.exe; independently verify bytes.
candidates.fixture_requirements: This is a filename-based file-creation predicate, not evidence that a driver was installed.

candidates.title: Suspicious Outbound SMTP Connections
candidates.behavior: Use ordinary TCP sockets to connect to a localhost echo fixture (127.0.0.1) on port 2525, send the fixed telemetry-lab marker, receive the fixed reply, and close. Verify the complete byte exchange at both ends. Keep the process alive for five seconds after I/O, equally in the same-binary control.
candidates.fixture_requirements: Use the same neutral executable path/name and localhost IPv4 destination across languages, outside all process exclusions. No protocol handshake, client library, authentication, or real application service is required by the rule. Pin source/peer setup; validate actual Sysmon EID 3 attribution.

detection.condition: network_connection and (selection and not 1 of filter_*)

candidates.title: Outbound RDP Connections Over Non-Standard Tools
candidates.behavior: Connect to the existing RDP listener at 127.0.0.1:3389, send the fixed 11-byte X.224 connection request, and close without authentication or a session. Hold the process alive for five seconds after I/O, equally in the same-binary control.
candidates.fixture_requirements: Existing Windows RDP listener; leave service configuration intact. Verify connect and complete send. The rule uses connection metadata, not payload contents. Keep address, payload, path and lifetime identical across languages.

detection.condition: network_connection and (selection and not 1 of filter_main_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*)

Verify the complete byte exchange at both ends. Keep the process alive for five seconds after I/O, equally in the same-binary control.

candidates.title: Network Connection Initiated From Process Located In Potentially Suspicious Or Uncommon Location
candidates.behavior: Execute the standalone program at C:\Users\Public\telemetry-lab\probe.exe and perform a TCP connect/send/receive exchange with a localhost echo fixture (127.0.0.1) on fixed port 49152. Keep the process alive for five seconds after I/O, equally in the same-binary control.
candidates.fixture_requirements: Hold the executable location constant across languages. Use a controlled destination hostname outside filter_main_domains. Stage the program before capture; observe the connection from the actual measured process, not a launcher. Confirm bytes received at both ends.

detection.condition: network_connection and (selection and not 1 of filter_main_*)

candidates.authors: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

candidates.title: Suspicious DNS Query for IP Lookup Service APIs
candidates.behavior: Resolve api.ipify.org against an isolated lab resolver that supplies a fixed local answer.
candidates.fixture_requirements: No HTTP client or public service contact. Preserve the hostname, answer, and DNS-cache baseline across languages; independently verify lookup results and resolver request. Keep the executable outside browser image exclusions. Use a harness-only UDP responder on 127.0.0.1:53 and temporary exact-name NRPT entries. Return 127.0.0.42 with zero TTL; remove entries and clear cache afterward.

detection.condition: dns_query and (selection and not 1 of filter_optional_*)

candidates.title: Suspicious Double Extension File Execution
candidates.behavior: Launch a fixed benign report.pdf.exe helper with the same command line and verify its marker and exit code.
candidates.fixture_requirements: Both Image and CommandLine must match. Control uses the same parent program but does not spawn the matching child.
candidates.authors: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), @blu3_team (idea), Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

candidates.title: File Creation Date Changed to Another Year
candidates.behavior: Change a harness-seeded file creation time from a fixed 2026 value to a fixed 2019 value; read the timestamp back.
candidates.fixture_requirements: This rule compares the 202 prefix, not any year change: 2026 to 2025 would not match. Avoid .tmp/.temp and excluded paths.

detection.condition: file_change and (selection and not 1 of filter_main_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*)

candidates.title: Hidden Executable In NTFS Alternate Data Stream
candidates.behavior: Write a fixed benign PE with a nonzero import hash to an NTFS alternate data stream and verify its bytes.
candidates.fixture_requirements: Requires Sysmon EID 15 and IMPHASH in Hash. Do not execute the stream; confirm capture and hash fields during qualification.

detection.condition: create_stream_hash and (selection and not 1 of filter_main_*)

candidates.title: Malicious Named Pipe Created
candidates.behavior: Create the named pipe \testPipe, connect a controlled client and exchange a fixed marker.
candidates.fixture_requirements: This tests a listed pipe-name indicator; it does not emulate the malware families in the rule description. Keep client activity separately attributable.

candidates.title: Unsigned .node File Loaded
candidates.behavior: Load a fixed benign unsigned DLL fixture with a .node extension into the measured process; call a harmless exported function.
candidates.fixture_requirements: Same helper bytes in every language; verify load and function result. Requires EID 7 plus Signed=false or SignatureStatus=Unavailable; Node.js execution is not claimed.

detection.condition: image_load and (all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*)

deferred_candidates.decision: Successful local A resolution in all eight configurations produced Sysmon Image=<unknown process>, which this unmodified rule explicitly excludes. No qualifying positive baseline in the first balanced live pass. Defer from onboarded scope; retain all pilot observations and do not modify the rule or use per-runtime workarounds.
